# Analysis

$$
\begin{aligned}
Q(d) &= \sum_{i=1}^{n}(y_i-d)^2 \\
Q(d) &= \sum_{i=1}^{n}y_i^2-2d\sum_{i=1}^{n}y_i+nd^2 \\
Q(0) &= \sum_{i=1}^{n}y_i^2 \\
Q'(d) &= -2\sum_{i=1}^{n}y_i+2nd \\
0 &= -2\sum_{i=1}^{n}y_i+2nd \\
d &= \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}y_i
\end{aligned}
$$
